system.name: Inflationary Flows
system.one_liner: Repurposes diffusion-based models, through their probability flow ODE, into invertible, neighbourhood-preserving maps to a low-dimensional Gaussian for calibrated Bayesian inference.

content.variant_note: one two-moons toy set drawn in three snapshots along a diagonal in each of three columns (SDE, Fokker-Planck, pfODE), with the governing equation under each column
content.argues: The SDE and the pfODE give the same marginals described by one Fokker-Planck equation, but the SDE is noisy and mixing while the pfODE is deterministic and neighbourhood-preserving.
content.subject: a two-moons toy dataset taken from data to Gaussian under an SDE, as its density, and under a pfODE, with the three governing equations

lessons.what_to_learn: To show that several descriptions of one process are equivalent but behave differently, draw the same coloured toy set at the same three times in each column and print each column's governing equation underneath; tracer colours make the qualitative difference visible.
lessons.suits: theory-motivated papers where one object has several equivalent descriptions (SDE, PDE, ODE; primal, dual) and the difference is qualitative.

summary: Inflationary flows repurpose diffusion-based models for calibrated Bayesian inference, and Figure 1 explains the SDE-ODE duality behind them. Three columns each repeat three snapshots of a two-moons toy set along a diagonal with labelled arrows and the governing equation underneath: a diffusion model that noises the data into a mixed Gaussian cloud, the Fokker-Planck equation drawn as blue density contours, and the probability flow ODE whose scatter keeps its colour layout while it inflates. Thick block arrows from both outer columns point to the middle one, showing that SDE and pfODE give rise to the same marginals.
summary_zh: 图用三列说明扩散模型的 SDE-ODE 对偶：左列对双月数据加噪去噪，中列 Fokker-Planck 方程给出同一串边缘密度（蓝色等高线），右列概率流 ODE 让点云保持邻域结构；每列下方印有方程，箭头表示两侧导出同一 FPE。
notes: Prior kind kept; side-by-side-contrast added because the caption contrasts the noisy SDE with the deterministic pfODE.
